title: Pure Royal
summary: Yugi Muto's Royal Straight Poker Knights—Royal Straight Slasher, Royal Straight, and the Queen's, King's, Jack's, and Joker's Knights—paired with Royal Decree and a 5-Level Warrior toolbox. Joker's Straight and Imperial Bower assemble all three Face Card Knights at once so Royal Straight can summon Royal Straight Slasher or Arcana Knight Joker.

summary.title: Starters
points: Joker's Straight discards 1 card to Special Summon Queen's Knight from the Deck, adds King's Knight or Jack's Knight from the Deck to the hand, and immediately Normal Summons King's Knight so its effect pulls Jack's Knight from the Deck.

Imperial Bower Tributes itself while you control no other monsters to take two different monsters among Queen's Knight, King's Knight, and Jack's Knight from your Deck and either add them to your hand or Special Summon them.
Joker's Knight sends Queen's Knight, King's Knight, or Jack's Knight from your Deck to the GY to Special Summon itself from the hand and copy that monster's name until the End Phase.
Sublimation Knight equips Squeaknight from the Deck on Normal Summon to put two Warriors on the field while serving as the Level 3 monster in the Deck.

summary.title: Opening: Joker's Straight + Royal Straight
steps: Activate Joker's Straight to Special Summon Queen's Knight, search King's Knight, and Normal Summon King's Knight to Special Summon Jack's Knight from the Deck.

Activate the Quick-Play Spell Royal Straight to send Queen's Knight, King's Knight, and Jack's Knight from your hand and/or field to the GY and Special Summon Royal Straight Slasher from your hand, Deck, or GY (or Arcana Knight Joker from the Extra Deck).
During the End Phase, return LIGHT Warriors from your GY to the Deck to add Joker's Straight and Joker's Knight back to your hand.

summary.title: Royal Straight Slasher's 5-Level Board Wipe
summary.text: While Queen's Knight, King's Knight, and Jack's Knight are all in your GY, Royal Straight Slasher can send 5 monsters with different Levels of 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5 from your hand and/or Deck to the GY to destroy all cards your opponent controls. This list runs Infernoble Knight - Renaud (Level 1), Hero Kid (Level 2), Sublimation Knight (Level 3), Queen's or King's Knight (Level 4), and Jack's or Joker's Knight (Level 5) so the 5-card send is always live from the Deck.

summary.title: Bosses & Extra Deck
points: Arcana Knight Joker (3800 ATK) and Arcana Extra Joker (2800 ATK) negate any Spell, Trap, or monster effect that targets them on the field by discarding the same card type.
Constellar Pleiades overlays Level 5 Jack's Knight and Joker's Knight to bounce any card on the field as a Quick Effect.

Ferocious Flame Swordsman boosts all Warriors by 500 ATK and revives a non-Link Warrior when destroyed, Note that Joker's Straight locks you into LIGHT Warrior Extra Deck summons for the rest of the turn.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Royal Decree negates all other Trap effects on the field, clearing the way for Royal Straight Slasher's OTK.

Joker's Wild sends Joker's Straight or Royal Straight from your Deck to the GY during either Main Phase or Battle Phase to copy that Spell's effect on the opponent's turn and recycles itself in the End Phase.

allow.Sublimation Knight: Level 3 FIRE Warrior: serves as the exact Level 3 monster in your Deck for Royal Straight Slasher's 5-Level (Levels 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5) board-wipe effect, and equips Squeaknight on Normal Summon to put 2 Warriors on board for Link Summoning!
allow.Squeaknight: Level 1 FIRE Warrior equipped by Sublimation Knight.
allow.Infernoble Knight - Renaud: Level 1 FIRE Warrior: serves as the exact Level 1 monster in your Deck for Royal Straight Slasher's 5-Level board-wipe effect, and recovers an Equip or FIRE Warrior.
allow.Hero Kid: Level 2 EARTH Warrior: serves as the exact Level 2 Warrior in your Deck to complete the Level 1 (Renaud), Level 2 (Hero Kid), Level 3 (Sublimation Knight), Level 4 (King's/Queen's Knight), and Level 5 (Jack's/Joker's Knight) requirement for Royal Straight Slasher's board wipe!
allow.Reinforcement of the Army: Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Imperial Bower, King's Knight, Queen's Knight, or Sublimation Knight.
allow.Ferocious Flame Swordsman: Link-2 FIRE Warrior that boosts all Warrior monsters by 500 ATK and revives a non-Link Warrior monster from your GY when destroyed by battle or card effect!
allow.Constellar Pleiades: Rank 5 LIGHT Warrior/Xyz summoned using Level 5 Jack's Knight + Level 5 Joker's Knight that bounces a card on the field as a Quick Effect!

main: Royal Straight Slasher

Signature Level 6 LIGHT Warrior boss (2400 ATK): Must be Special Summoned with 'Royal Straight'; while Queen's, King's, and Jack's Knight are in GY, sends 5 monsters with Levels 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5 from hand/Deck to GY to destroy ALL cards your opponent controls; revives 3 LIGHT Warriors if destroyed by battle!
Joker's Knight

Core Level 5 LIGHT Warrior (2000 ATK): sends Queen's, King's, or Jack's Knight from Deck to GY to Special Summon itself from hand and copy that sent monster's name; recycles itself from GY during End Phase!
Imperial Bower
Core Level 4 LIGHT Warrior starter: while you control no other monsters, tributes itself to add or Special Summon 2 different monsters from your Deck among Queen's, King's, and Jack's Knight!
King's Knight
Level 4 LIGHT Warrior: when Normal Summoned while you control Queen's Knight, Special Summons 1 Jack's Knight directly from your Deck—immediately assembling all 3 Knights for Royal Straight!
Queen's Knight
Level 4 LIGHT Warrior Normal Monster (1500 ATK): summoned from Deck by Joker's Straight and Imperial Bower to trigger King's Knight and satisfy Royal Straight.
Jack's Knight
Level 5 LIGHT Warrior Normal Monster (1900 ATK): summoned from Deck by King's Knight, Joker's Straight, or Imperial Bower, and serves as the Level 5 monster for Royal Straight Slasher.
Sublimation Knight
Level 3 Warrior: serves as the Level 3 monster sent from your Deck by Royal Straight Slasher's board wipe, or equips Squeaknight to make Ferocious Flame Swordsman.
Hero Kid
Level 2 Warrior: serves as the Level 2 monster sent from your Deck by Royal Straight Slasher's board wipe.
Infernoble Knight - Renaud
Level 1 Warrior: serves as the Level 1 monster sent from your Deck by Royal Straight Slasher's board wipe.
Squeaknight
Equipped from the Deck by Sublimation Knight to provide extra Warrior Link Material.
Royal Straight
Signature Quick-Play Spell: sends Queen's, King's, and Jack's Knight from hand/field to GY to Special Summon 'Royal Straight Slasher' (from hand, Deck, or GY!) OR 'Arcana Knight Joker'!
Joker's Straight

Core Spell: discards 1 card, Special Summons Queen's Knight from Deck, adds King's or Jack's Knight from Deck to hand, and immediately Normal Summons King's Knight to pull Jack's Knight—putting all 3 Knights on field!
Reinforcement of the Army
Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Imperial Bower, King's Knight, Queen's Knight, or Sublimation Knight.
Joker's Wild
Normal Trap: sends Joker's Straight or Royal Straight from Deck to GY and copies that Spell's effect as a Quick Effect!
Royal Decree
Iconic 'Royal' Continuous Trap: negates all other Trap effects on the field—protecting your Royal Straight Slasher OTK from opposing Trap cards while your engine runs on Spells!
extra: Level 9 LIGHT Warrior Fusion boss (3800 ATK): summoned directly from the Extra Deck by Royal Straight; discards the same card type to negate any targeting effect!
Link-3 LIGHT Warrior boss (2800 ATK): negates targeting effects by discarding the same card type, and revives Queen's Knight from Deck and searches a Level 4 Warrior on battle destruction!
Link-2 FIRE Warrior that boosts all Warrior monsters by 500 ATK and revives a non-Link Warrior monster from your GY when destroyed by battle or card effect!
Rank 5 LIGHT Xyz (summoned using Level 5 Joker's Knight + Level 5 Jack's Knight!) that detaches 1 material as a Quick Effect to bounce 1 card on the field to the hand.
